## 7. Assumptions and risks
- Reach is estimated from feedback volume, which over-represents vocal customers and under-represents silent ones.
- Sentiment is lexicon-based (VADER) and can misread sarcasm, technical language and very short text.
- Theme membership comes from unsupervised clustering and may include loosely related records.
- Impact, confidence and effort are team estimates.
